clue.text: Service provided in mountain range

parts.note: a Mass is a church service
'provided' as in 'provided that' means if

explanation.surface: A church service is held somewhere up in the mountains.
explanation.definitionFit: A massif is a compact group of mountains forming a distinct block within a larger chain.

clue.text: Do I have the ability to drink cold cordial?

indicators.note: the question phrase takes in, drinks, the cold letter

parts.note: turned into a question this is 'am I able'

explanation.surface: Someone wonders if they can manage a glass of chilled cordial.
explanation.walkthrough: Cordial looks like the drink but is the adjective: friendly.
explanation.definitionFit: Amicable and cordial both describe friendly, good-natured relations.

clue.text: Bless City fans going crazy

indicators.note: crazy suggests the letters of city fans run wild into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Football supporters of City go wild and are blessed.
explanation.definitionFit: To sanctify is to make holy or consecrate, as a priest does in blessing.

clue.text: Bewildered clodhopper arrested by G-man

indicators.note: the clumsy oaf is held within the agent's word, as a suspect is arrested

parts.note: a G-man is an FBI agent, in US slang a fed
a lummox is a clumsy oaf, a clodhopper

explanation.surface: A clumsy lout is baffled when an FBI agent arrests him.
explanation.definitionFit: Flummoxed means perplexed or confused, completely baffled.

clue.text: Applaud what hip-hoppers do, over time? Rubbish

indicators.note: in this across clue the rap is said to come over, here after, the time letter

parts.note: to applaud is to clap
hip-hop artists rap

explanation.surface: Someone sneers at clapping and rapping as so much nonsense.
explanation.definitionFit: Claptrap is pretentious nonsense, empty talk: a near-synonym of rubbish.

clue.text: Dismissing minor complaint over long Rushdie novel

indicators.note: in a down clue the cold sits over, above, the rest

parts.note: a cold is a minor illness

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters are rearranged afresh

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A reader with a cold struggles through a long Salman Rushdie novel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like Rushdie's book but signals the letters being reworked.
explanation.definitionFit: Cold-shouldering someone is ignoring or rebuffing them, a deliberate snub.

clue.text: Illegally took ring covered in awfully cheap diamonds

indicators.note: the ring letter is enclosed by the rearranged word
awful handling of cheap rearranges it

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged
a ring is the round letter O

explanation.surface: A thief nicked a ring set with nasty cheap diamonds.
explanation.walkthrough: D is the card abbreviation for diamonds.
explanation.definitionFit: To poach is to take game or goods unlawfully, as from another's land.

clue.text: Film with John Wayne and rhinos oddly well done

indicators.note: oddly means take the odd-numbered letters of rhinos

parts.note: its first, third and fifth letters are taken
bravo is a cry of well done

explanation.surface: A cowboy picture features John Wayne alongside rhinos, to applause.
explanation.definitionFit: Rio Bravo is a 1959 Western directed by Howard Hawks, starring John Wayne.

clue.text: Doorway and door stripped off for temporary convenience

parts.note: a portal is a doorway

indicators.note: the door has its outer letters peeled away, leaving the middle

parts.note: the word door minus its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A doorway and door are removed to make a temporary facility.
explanation.walkthrough: A Portaloo is the British trade name for a portable toilet; a convenience is a toilet.
explanation.definitionFit: A Portaloo is a portable toilet, a convenience set up temporarily at events.

clue.text: AC/DC cancel touring America twice yearly

parts.note: slang for bisexual, abbreviated BI

indicators.note: the word for cancel goes around, touring, the America letter

parts.note: to annul is to cancel

explanation.surface: The rock band AC/DC call off an American tour.
explanation.walkthrough: AC/DC looks like the band but is slang for bisexual, giving BI.
explanation.definitionFit: Biannual means occurring two times each year, distinct from biennial (every second year).

clue.text: Prefer a virtuoso's opening in quartet

indicators.note: the a and virtuoso's opening sit inside the word for quartet

parts.note: a quartet is four
taken as written

indicators.note: the opening of virtuoso is its first letter

parts.note: the first letter of virtuoso

explanation.surface: One prefers a virtuoso to open a string quartet's performance.
explanation.definitionFit: To favour something is to prefer it or show partiality towards it.

clue.text: Head for platform like X for entertaining activities

indicators.note: the head of platform is its first letter

parts.note: the first letter of platform
as means like
x is the multiplication sign, read as times

explanation.surface: A railway passenger heads for the platform marked X.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastimes are hobbies, the things one does for enjoyment in spare time.

clue.text: That lady's in health resort, one found in the Himalayas

indicators.note: the word for that lady is placed inside the spa

parts.note: a spa is a health resort
that lady is her; the 's stands for 'is' and joins

explanation.surface: A woman at a spa meets a mountain guide from the Himalayas.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sherpas are a people of Nepal's Himalayan region, famed as mountaineering guides and porters.

clue.text: Canine that hunts following bullock and badger

parts.note: a bullock is a castrated ox
to badger is to hound, harass

explanation.surface: A hunting dog trails a bullock and a badger across the fields.
explanation.walkthrough: F is the abbreviation for following; 'badger' is the verb (pester), not the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A foxhound is a breed of dog bred to hunt foxes by scent in packs.

clue.text: One dreamt, strangely, what one might see in Paris

definitions.text: what one might see in Paris

indicators.note: strangely says the letters of one dreamt are oddly arranged

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone dreams oddly of the sights of Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: Notre-Dame is the Gothic cathedral on the Île de la Cité, a famous Paris landmark.

clue.text: Really unknown cleric from the east

indicators.note: in an across clue, reading from the east means right to left, backwards

parts.note: y is a mathematical unknown
Rev, short for Reverend, is a cleric

explanation.surface: An Eastern clergyman is truly obscure.
explanation.definitionFit: Very and really are interchangeable intensifiers: very good, really good.

clue.text: Energetic Russian chap housed by you in France

indicators.note: the man is lodged inside the French word

parts.note: vous is French for you
Igor is a typical Russian man's name

explanation.surface: A lively Russian man stays with you in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Vigorous means strong, active and full of energy.

clue.text: Do some pondering right before playing Man U tie

indicators.note: the right letter comes before the rest in this down clue
the letters of Man U tie are played about with

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A fan thinks hard before a Manchester United match.
explanation.walkthrough: Man U is Manchester United football club; a tie is a match.
explanation.definitionFit: To ruminate is to think deeply and at length, to mull things over.

clue.text: Chanel's business doubled

definitions.note: the definition names whose first name it is: Chanel's first name

indicators.note: doubled says the abbreviation is written twice

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a business

explanation.surface: The fashion house's trade has grown twofold.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is 'Chanel's', short for Chanel's first name.
explanation.definitionFit: Coco was the nickname used as the first name of the French designer Gabrielle Chanel.

clue.text: Best starters from top eatery — amazing refreshments

parts.note: the cream is the best part

indicators.note: the starters are each word's first letter

parts.note: the first letters of top, eatery and amazing

explanation.surface: A top restaurant serves fabulous snacks.
explanation.walkthrough: A cream tea is British: tea with scones, jam and clotted cream.
explanation.definitionFit: A cream tea is an afternoon spread of tea and scones with jam and cream, light refreshments.

clue.text: Old compiler thus, with trim clothing, leaves the closet

indicators.note: trim clothes, wraps around, the other pieces

parts.note: to trim is to cut
the compiler, the setter, refers to himself as me
so means thus

explanation.surface: An old setter in neat clothes steps out of a wardrobe.
explanation.definitionFit: To come out (of the closet) is to declare one's sexuality openly.

clue.text: Sinner and I party behind vicar's back

parts.note: taken as written
a do is a party
behind schedule is late

indicators.note: the back of the vicar is the final letter of that word

parts.note: the word vicar itself, whose back is taken

explanation.surface: A sinner joins a party round at the back of the vicar's house.
explanation.definitionFit: Worshipping idols is a sin in the Bible, so an idol-worshipper is a sinner.

clue.text: Bury bags for example, maybe two or three

indicators.note: bags here means grabs and holds, so the example abbreviation goes inside

parts.note: to inter is to bury

explanation.surface: Someone buries a few bags, say two or three.
explanation.walkthrough: Bury looks like the Lancashire town but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Two and three are examples of whole numbers, integers.

clue.text: Painkiller one swallowed after work

indicators.note: the one and swallowed come after the work abbreviation

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
ate means swallowed

explanation.surface: Someone takes a painkiller after a day's work.
explanation.definitionFit: Opiates such as morphine are drugs derived from opium used to relieve pain.

clue.text: Raised tax in English city in Yorkshire, briefly

indicators.note: the tax sits inside English plus the shortened city
briefly means the city loses its last letter

parts.note: Leeds is a city in Yorkshire
VAT is value added tax

explanation.surface: A tax has been raised in a Yorkshire city.
explanation.walkthrough: VAT is the UK's value added tax, a sales tax.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevated means lifted up, set higher: a synonym of raised.

clue.text: Zero variety in Trump's complexion?

parts.note: a range is a variety, an assortment

explanation.surface: Nothing varies about Donald Trump's famous tan.
explanation.definitionFit: Donald Trump is often mocked for his orange-tinted skin, hence the question mark marking a joke example.

clue.text: Sides in Indian battle doing nothing

indicators.note: the sides of Indian are its first and last letters

parts.note: the first and last letters of Indian
action is fighting, battle

explanation.surface: Indian soldiers sit idle on both sides during a battle.
explanation.definitionFit: Inaction is the state of doing nothing, the absence of activity.

clue.text: Carol catches Don using profanities

indicators.note: the singing word holds, catches, the word for don

parts.note: to carol is to sing
to don clothes is to wear them

explanation.surface: Carol catches a man called Don cursing.
explanation.walkthrough: Carol and Don look like people's names but are verbs: sing and wear.
explanation.definitionFit: Swearing is the use of offensive language, uttering profanities.

clue.text: Praises evangelist lax etiquette holds back

indicators.note: the held letters are read in the opposite direction
the phrase holds the letters within it

parts.note: the run of letters spanning the end of evangelist, lax and the start of etiquette

explanation.surface: An evangelist praises the relaxed manners of the faithful.
explanation.definitionFit: To exalt someone is to praise them highly, glorify them.
